classification: unsupported private Future mutation; no task scope expansion
observation: A BaseException raised by an externally attached queued Future callback can interrupt the _shutdown Future iteration before all private state is cleared. _settle protects its own signal in finally.
supported_path_review: request and request_many return ReadResult, never expose concurrent.futures.Future.
ReadResult.progress is bound to a compact Event signal, not the Future.
No production dashboard code calls add_done_callback, Future.cancel or Future.set_exception.
Creation and settlement of service-owned Futures are under the service condition, so the not-done check/set-result transition has no supported external race.

The only dashboard add_done_callback occurrence is intentional fault injection in tests/test_dashboard_source_recovery.py:623. The runtime derivatives_context asyncio task callback is a separate mechanism.
claim_boundary: Builder/iterator cleanup/unexpected worker failures settle normal service-owned Futures and signals. This is not a guarantee against arbitrary mutation or BaseException callbacks attached through private _jobs.
action: Do not edit production code or expand tests for unsupported private Future mutation. Retain scope note alongside final QA verdict.
